---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new feature for Penghu Cool-Ride
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]
assignees: ""
---

## 🚀 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
*(Example: "I'm always frustrated when trying to plan a night ride because...")*

## 💡 Proposed Solution / Feature
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this feature improves the routing engine, tourist safety, or user experience.

## 🔬 Scientific / Academic Rationale (If Applicable)
If proposing a new biometeorological formula, thermal index (e.g. PET, UTCI, PMV), or mathematical optimization technique, please provide relevant citations, journal references, or standards (e.g. ISO, ASHRAE).

## 🎨 Mockups / UI Concept
If applicable, include sketches, diagrams, or UI mockups of how the feature could look in `app.html` or `index.html`.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, API sources, or notes about the feature request here.
